business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- "Leading Global Industrial packaging company" with "Dominant market position with over 55% market share in domestic Industrial packaging", "World's largest manufacturer of large size plastic drums" and "Market leader in 9 out of 11 countries it operates in".
- "First to launch Type-IV Composite Cylinder for LPG, CNG (CNG cascade and on-board application), and Hydrogen in India. 2nd Largest Composite Cylinder manufacturer worldwide."
- "First to launch Intermediate Bulk Container (IBC) in India and 3rd Largest IBC manufacturer worldwide"; also "2nd largest MOX film manufacturer in India" and "Major Player in manufacturing of HDPE pipes in India".
- Regulatory approvals are the stated barrier to entry: "1st and only company in India to receive PESO approval for manufacturing of Type-IV CNG cylinders for Cascade and on-board applications" and "1st company in India to receive PESO approval for manufacturing of High-Pressure Type-IV Composite Cylinders for Hydrogen"; the Type-III breathing-air/medical-oxygen cylinder was the "1st locally manufactured cylinder to get approval from PESO in India".
- Franchise depth: "14+ recognized brands with over 900 institutional customers globally" and a "Well established in-house R&D team of over 30 people combined experience of 450+ years".

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- A QIP was raised in FY26 - the cash flow shows "Increase in Share Capital Including Premium 8,000" Mn with share issue expenses of Rs 159 Mn - and is being deployed into automation and debt reduction; share capital rose to Rs 494 Mn (FY26) from Rs 227 Mn (FY25) and Other Equity to Rs 40,389 Mn from Rs 28,694 Mn.
- Deleveraging and cash: "Debt (Net of Cash) reduced by Rs 897 Mn" in Q1FY27 with "Cash Generated from Operating Activities Rs 1,552 Mn" in Q1FY27; FY26 net cash flow from operating activities was Rs 2,332 Mn versus Rs 4,305 Mn in FY25, on Working Capital Changes of (5,355) Mn.
- Returns focus is explicit: "FY26 ROCE stood at 18.9%, reflecting the near-term impact of automation investments funded through the QIP" and "The Company is targeting an annual ROCE improvement of 1.5-2.0% through automation, machinery and mold re-engineering, and working capital optimization."
- Asset recycling: non-core assets "worth ~Rs 134 Cr as on 31st March 2026" identified, of which "Rs 9 Cr in Q1 FY27" was disposed and "balance of Rs 125 Cr is expected to be monetized over the next 18-24 months"; Assets Classified As Held For Sale stand at Rs 1,340 Mn (FY26) versus Rs 516 Mn (FY25).
- Dividend paid in FY26 was Rs 589 Mn (FY25: Rs 470 Mn) per the consolidated cash flow; no dividend policy or payout ratio is stated.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Acquisitions] Systoverse Private Ltd - 76% stake, completed 10th June 2026, HDPE pipes / Maharashtra, ~Rs 25 Cr total projected investment. Ebullient Packaging Private Ltd - after "the Board's review of the MOU executed in FY 2025-26 and a thorough assessment of prevailing geographical market conditions, it has been decided to extend the review period before arriving at a final decision regarding the proposed acquisition".
- [Order book & tenders] Q1FY27 key highlights list a "Confirm Tender received for Supply of Packaging Products" of Rs 3,900 Mn, a composite cylinders (CNG cascades) order book of Rs 1,850 Mn and a PE Pipes order book of Rs 2,350 Mn; separately, "The Company secured an order from HPCL for the supply of 1,40,000 units of 10 kg Composite LPG Cylinders, with an order value of approximately Rs 38 Cr."
- [LPG route change] On the 14.2 kg composite LPG cylinder: "Considering current geopolitical uncertainties, the Board has recommended pursuing JVs/tie-ups with private gas distributors to establish an independent LPG distribution network, while continuing discussions for approvals and tenders"; supplies of lightweight Type IV composite LPG cylinders have commenced "for the HPCL-Swiggy Instamart pilot in Bengaluru". Context cited: India has "~32.68 Cr active LPG connections and over 50 Cr cylinders in circulation".
- [Battery subsidiary] Power Build Batteries Private Limited (subsidiary) received "CPRI certification for OPzS stationary tubular batteries in transparent SAN containers across multiple capacity variants" and "has entered into a multi-year exclusive agreement with Monbat AD, Bulgaria, for the supply of advanced VRLA stationary batteries in India", targeting "data centres, IT, BFSI, and other critical infrastructure applications".
- [Shareholding] As of 30th June 2026: Promoters 47.56% (unchanged from 31 Mar 2026), Domestic Institutional Investors 17.56% (+0.19%), Foreign Institutional Investors 8.54% (-2.34%), Public 26.33% (+2.15%).
